nodes.description: Laboratory scientific-analysis instrument platforms based on mass spectrometry, chromatography, molecular or atomic spectroscopy, electron optics, and X-ray methods; generic electronic test equipment, industrial inline inspection, and medical imaging are excluded.
Laboratory thermal, electrochemical, automation, and sample-preparation instruments used to prepare or characterize scientific samples; ordinary lab furniture and generic consumables are excluded.

Instrument-owned integration of sources, detectors, optics, vacuum paths, motion, signal chains, data conversion, and control software while preserving neighboring-chain ownership of generic components.

Certification, standards, tenders, customer validation, installed base, software, consumables, service, and recognized instrument revenue; plans or distributor-only relationships do not prove direct ownership.

Laboratory or scientific mass spectrometers and chromatography-mass-spectrometry platforms with direct product evidence; industrial leak detectors and industrial online mass spectrometers remain industrial inspection or process-analysis roles unless a laboratory instrument is separately evidenced.
Liquid, gas, ion, and other chromatography or separation instruments used in laboratory analysis, supported by direct products, user validation, or commercial revenue.

Molecular, atomic, Raman, fluorescence, infrared, emission, absorption, and related spectroscopy instruments or integrated scientific-analysis systems; production-line machine vision remains outside this chain.
Scientific electron microscopy and advanced optical microscopy instruments with direct complete-instrument evidence; medical imaging and generic optical parts do not qualify.
X-ray diffraction, X-ray fluorescence, coating-thickness, elemental-analysis, and related laboratory scientific instruments; medical X-ray imaging is excluded.
Calorimeters, thermal analyzers, electrochemical workstations, titration, and other direct laboratory characterization instruments; bundled third-party instruments do not confer ownership.

nodes.node_name: General Laboratory Automation and Sample Preparation
nodes.description: Automated digestion, extraction, purification, concentration, sample handling, and laboratory workflow instruments with direct self-developed product evidence; generic lab renovation and distribution are excluded.

nodes.node_name: Instrument Core Sources, Detectors, and Optics
nodes.description: Directly evidenced scientific-instrument optical sources, gratings, monochromators, detectors, and integrated optical subsystems; generic ADC, amplifier, vacuum, or optical-component ownership remains with neighboring chains.

nodes.node_name: Scientific Instrument Software, Consumables, and Service
nodes.description: Instrument-specific control software, validated methods, consumables, maintenance, calibration, and installed-base services; generic consumables and distributor-only sales are excluded.

nodes.node_name: Certification, Tender, Installed Base, and Revenue Validation
nodes.description: Separates standards or certification, tenders, user trials, batch delivery, installed base, service, and recognized revenue. A plan, prototype, tender, or distributor relationship alone cannot prove installed-base or revenue completion.
